headline: Know which rooms are ready instantly
body: Your front desk sees room status updates the moment housekeeping finishes. No internal phone calls. Faster check-ins.
caption:
Guests are waiting in your lobby after a long safari. Your front desk team is calling housekeeping to check if room 204 is ready.

With Operra, the moment housekeeping updates a room's status, the front desk sees it instantly. No internal phone calls. No manual checks. Just faster check-ins.

headline: Saa sita usiku bado unapitia risiti za karatasi?
body: Operra inaunganisha mapokezi na mgahawa ili kupata ripoti sahihi ya mauzo hapo hapo, bila kulazimika kusubiri usiku wa manane kufanya mahesabu.
caption:
Kulala ukiwa na wasiwasi kama hesabu za bar na mapokezi zimeoana ni mateso ya kila siku kwa mmiliki wa hoteli. 💤

Ukijaribu kusawazisha vitabu vya risiti kwa mkono, makosa madogo ya kibinadamu yanapoteza fedha zako. Operra inaleta mauzo yote kwenye mfumo mmoja rahisi unaofanya kazi hata kwenye mtandao mdogo wa simu.

headline: Every transaction is tracked
body: Operra records every payment, booking change, and refund automatically. Know exactly who did what, and when.
caption:
Where does the revenue go when you are not at the property? Discrepancies in daily receipts can quietly drain your profits.

Operra logs every transaction, reservation edit, and voided sale automatically. Your audit trail stays complete even on low-bandwidth connections.

Keep your revenue secure at operra.tech.

headline: Kazi haisimami hata mtandao ukiwa chini
body: Operra inafanya kazi vizuri kwenye mtandao mdogo wa hapa nchini. Huna haja ya kuwa na intaneti ya kasi kubwa ili kusimamia hoteli yako vizuri.
caption:
Changamoto ya mtandao isikurudishe nyuma kwenye huduma. Hoteli nyingi za hapa Tanzania zinakabiliwa na mtandao unaosuasua. Operra imeundwa mahususi kufanya kazi vizuri hata kwenye mtandao wa hali ya chini (low-bandwidth). Kuanzia mapokezi hadi jikoni, kila kitu kinaenda bila kukwama. Badili mfumo wako leo ili urahisishe uendeshaji wa hoteli yako.

headline: Local travelers expect instant check-ins
body: With regional travel rising, front desk and housekeeping must sync instantly to avoid lobby delays.
caption:
East African travelers are moving faster than ever. They book on the go and expect their rooms ready the moment they step into your lobby.

If your front desk is still calling housekeeping to check room status, guests wait. Operra syncs your reception and cleaning teams instantly, even on low-bandwidth connections. Keep your service fast and your reviews high.

caption:
Muda wa kukabidhi zamu ukifika, bado unatumia saa nzima kuuliza nani aliyetoa punguzo la bei kwenye chumba namba 10? 🔍

Ukiwa na Operra, kila muamala, malipo, au badiliko la bei linaandikwa na kuonyesha nani aliyefanya na kwa muda gani. Hakuna kupoteza muda kwenye vikao vya kuulizana. Kila kitu kiko wazi kwenye ripoti yako ya ukaguzi.

headline: Mteja amefika lakini chumba kina mtu tayari?
body: Kuzuia double-booking siyo kazi ya kubahatisha. Operra inaunganisha mapokezi na mauzo yako yote ili kuzuia migongano hii papo hapo.
caption:
Hakuna kitu kinacholeta aibu mapokezi kama mteja kufika usiku wa manane na kukuta chumba chake kimeshapangwa kwa mgeni mwingine. Kujaza vitabu kwa mkono au kutumia mifumo isiyosawazisha taarifa huleta migongano hii kila siku.

Operra inamaliza changamoto hii. Mfumo wetu unahuisha hali ya vyumba papo hapo ili kuzuia double-booking kwenye idara zote kwa wakati mmoja.
